response.rationale: I judged these to be related but different concepts. A, "Skate Hire", is about hiring skates as part of a booking. B, "Hire Skate Stock", is the stock count of hire skates for each size. In BookingService (src/business/bookingService.ts), A checks that stock: `if (this.stock.get(size) === 0) throw new DomainError(400, ...)`. The stock itself is defined in HireStockRepository (src/persistence/hireStockRepository.ts) as `private readonly stock = new Map<string, number>();`, and the graph shows BookingService calling HireStockRepository.get. So the hire activity depends on the stock, but one is a booking feature and the other is an inventory count. That makes it a dependency, not one concept under two names. My confidence is moderate because A's only quoted evidence is the stock check, so the two labels may have been drawn from the same idea.
